text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One evening, while walking through the city on our way back from an outing with Twin Turbo—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ah—! It's Falco and the others!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon, Mihono Bourbon,
and Silence Suzuka were working on something.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "Falco~! What are you doing here?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Turbo-chan! We're about to put on a concert♪
Together with Bourbon-chan and Suzuka-chan☆
choice_data_list: So it's a street performance, huh.
So it's a street performance, huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa!! A street performance!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That has a pretty cool ring to it!
Sounds so fun~~!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Turbo-chan, are you interested in
street performances too!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: There is! There totally is!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't you come on as a special guest right now?!
I'll pick the songs to match Turbo-chan☆

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh?
That's so sudden..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay!!
Turbo's gonna do a street live showww!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Twin Turbo ended up making a surprise guest appearance
in Smart Falcon and the others' "Breakaway Live."

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Run it to the wire!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Hold the lead to the end!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Because I WANT YOU!!
There's no second place in love~♪
Blow them away, super express!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps influenced by Smart Falcon, Twin Turbo's
singing and dancing were even more full of energy than usual.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Way to gooo!!
Turbo-chan, you were so cute~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ehehe!! Thank you so muuuch~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how did Turbo do, Trainer!?
Was Turbo awesome!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, she looked like she was having a lot of fun.
Yeah, you looked like you were having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, how did Turbo do, Trainer!?
Was Turbo awesome!?
choice_data_list: Yeah, she looked like she was having a lot of fun.
Yeah, you looked like you were having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, ain't that right~!?
Falco was going all ROOOAAAR and working hard,
so Turbo tried just as hard!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that was amazing! Maybe she's got what it takes
to be a front-running Umadol☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I know!
Why don't you join in on the next live show if you want?!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Are you serious!?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? You can say no, you know?
Lives take a lot of work, after all...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No, Turbo wants to do it!
I wanna do more lives with Falco, Suzuka, and Bourbon!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Let's pick a date then☆
Our next plan is, umm—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... Dragged into it again...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Seriously!!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally that☆ Her engine was roaring full blast!
VROOOM VROOOOM~~!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~~!! Helios and Palmer,
you were watching too~?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Turbo was super sharp out there!
It made us want to dance too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wait... really!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, Helios-san, Palmer-san,
why don't you two join in next time!?
Let's do a massive live together♪

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"What's that, super hype☆
Let's totally do it!! Waaaay!!"

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ayyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You've gotta be kidding me... they're just multiplying...
